description: A traditional American suburban residential front yard photographed at early dusk, with a transitional moment of warm artificial light activating against a still-bright pale grey-blue sky. The foreground is dominated by a low curved garden wall built from stacked cream-colored limestone or sandy-toned natural stone blocks with a smooth limestone coping cap, forming a gentle arc around a circular front garden bed. The garden bed inside the curved wall is planted with purple and pink flowering perennials — alyssum, lavender or verbena — filling the bed with dense color. At the center of the curved bed, a white painted classical stone bird bath or fountain with a two-tier basin holds a potted arrangement of bright red geraniums. The driveway or entry court is paved in grey interlocking concrete or brick pavers. In the right background, a traditional two-story red brick house with grey fiber cement siding on the upper gable section and dark grey dimensional shingles is softly out of focus. A covered side porch with white columns and black wrought iron garden furniture — round table and chairs with decorative motifs — is partially visible to the right. Warm light from the residential interior glows through the French door and windows of the porch. A warm amber glow emanates from a traditionally styled post-cap lantern mounted atop the foreground stone pillar, its flame-like light source visible through the seeded glass panels. Camera is at standing eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, shooting an off-center thirds view focusing on the stone pillar post and the garden bed beyond. Lens is a normal focal length.
